_meta.category: Addiction, Substance Use & Recovery — Deep Research
_meta.description: 527 data points covering addiction prevalence, treatment outcomes, relapse rates, recovery timelines, costs, overdose deaths, behavioral addictions (gambling, gaming, social media, porn), economic costs, youth trends, psychedelic therapy, drug courts, recovery capital, and medication-assisted treatment. All from verifiable sources (SAMHSA, WHO, CDC, NIDA, Lancet, Cochrane, PMC/NIH, OECD).
